# Chat wire fixtures

These credential-free SSE transcripts are synthetic recordings of the documented
OpenAI-compatible streaming shape, not captured live-provider traffic. They cover
text, interleaved multi-tool argument fragments, reported/absent usage, length
termination and a structured context error. They contain no real model/key/data.
Loopback tests combine them with shared Core retries, tools, reduction and saved
usage. They do not qualify Gemini or any other real provider or caching policy.
